sentiment.label: risk_off
sentiment.reason_it: Il VIX a 17,20 (sotto 18) indica un mercato poco difensivo, ma l'S&P 500 è sceso del -0,30% nella seduta di venerdì, segnalando pressione ribassista. Il DXY è a 101,82 (-0,22%), il che tende a sostenere le commodity, ma il Brent è a $111,61 (-2,85%) e l'oro a $3.998,60 (-0,81%), entrambi in calo. La combinazione di VIX basso, equity negativo e commodity in ribasso genera un sentiment di risk‑off moderato, con un punteggio di 5 su 10.
sentiment.reason_en: The VIX at 17.20 (below 18) suggests a non‑defensive market, yet the S&P 500 fell by -0.30% in Friday's session, indicating bearish pressure. The DXY sits at 101.82 (-0.22%), which would normally aid commodities, but Brent is at $111.61 (-2.85%) and gold at $3,998.60 (-0.81%), both declining. The mix of low VIX, negative equity, and falling commodities yields a moderate risk‑off sentiment, scored at 5 out of 10.

market_impact_summary.it: Equity: S&P 500 -0,30% (risk‑off); Euro‑Stoxx 600 +0,14% (leggero supporto). Fixed income: TLT +0,62% e US 10Y yield a 4,98% (-1,11% bp), segnale di compressione dei rendimenti. Commodity: Brent -2,85% e oro -0,81% indicano pressione inflazionistica contenuta, mentre il DXY -0,22% favorisce le valute emergenti. La combinazione di equity in calo, rendimenti in compressione e commodity deboli conferma un contesto di risk‑off.
market_impact_summary.en: Equities: S&P 500 -0.30% (risk‑off); Euro‑Stoxx 600 +0.14% (slight support). Fixed income: TLT +0.62% and US 10Y yield at 4.98% (-1.11 bp), indicating yield compression. Commodities: Brent -2.85% and gold -0.81% show limited inflation pressure, while DXY -0.22% benefits emerging currencies. The mix of falling equities, compressed yields, and weak commodities confirms a risk‑off environment.

The EU’s Industrial Accelerator Act (IAA) is pushing the UK toward an economic confrontation with China it would rather avoid. The IAA plans to introduce new ‘Made in Europe’ obligations, conditioning access to certain public subsidy and procurement schemes on the use of sufficient local, European, content. This is intended, in part, to protect European industry from cheap, high-quality, Chinese goods such as hybrid and electric vehicles (EVs).
